input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. Raw magical broad squat amphibian-like bog creature, four short splayed legs, heavy moss-green stone hide, broad round mouth, luminous turquoise throat sac, root tendrils and wet mist. Chunky artillery silhouette; intact non-gory creature. FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally TOWARD viewer and image RIGHT, face and front surfaces clearly visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FIVE columns and TWO rows: TEN complete poses, same anatomical scale, no text. Read left to right: poses 1-4 QUICK FLINCH: 1 ready; 2 head and shoulders jerk backward visibly; 3 legs catch balance; 4 fully recovered ready. Poses 5-10 HEAVY STAGGER: 5 ready; 6 abrupt head and torso recoil; 7 deepest hunched recoil and visibly lost balance; 8 legs splay and bend to catch weight; 9 pushing back toward ready; 10 fully recovered ready. Show clear torso articulation and varied leg support; not repeated standing duplicates. Keep FOUR animal feet and natural creature anatomy, no rearing, no human arms. No falling or lying poses in this sheet. The difference between ready and peak recoil must read at small game size. Wide empty gutters, no clipped parts. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt:
Original painted 2D game character animation sheet on a solid uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Exactly 5 columns and 2 rows containing 10 distinct animation poses arranged in a clean grid with wide empty magenta gutters and margins. Aspect ratio 1:1.

Character identity and anatomy matching visual references: The Mire Maw, a raw magical broad squat amphibian-like bog creature with four short splayed animal legs, heavy moss-green stone hide, broad round mouth, luminous glowing turquoise throat sac, root tendrils, and subtle wet mist. Pure animal creature only, chunky artillery silhouette, four animal feet, no human body, no clothes, no weapons. Lighter stylized painted values and clean sculpted shapes matching reference-1 and reference-2.

Perspective: Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic angle. In all 10 poses, the creature is in FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, with its head and torso facing diagonally forward toward the viewer and image right, keeping its face and front chest/sac clearly visible.

Animation sequence layout (10 poses across 5 columns, 2 rows, reading left-to-right, identical anatomical scale, each creature centered within middle 60% of its cell, no clipping or touching borders):

Top row (poses 1 to 5):
- Pose 1 (Row 1, Col 1): QUICK FLINCH - Ready alert combat stance, broad squat posture on four legs.
- Pose 2 (Row 1, Col 2): QUICK FLINCH - Head and shoulders jerk backward visibly from light impact, throat sac tightens.
- Pose 3 (Row 1, Col 3): QUICK FLINCH - Four legs brace and catch balance, absorbing the jolt.
- Pose 4 (Row 1, Col 4): QUICK FLINCH - Fully recovered ready combat stance.
- Pose 5 (Row 1, Col 5): HEAVY STAGGER - Ready combat stance receiving heavy strike.

Bottom row (poses 6 to 10):
- Pose 6 (Row 2, Col 1): HEAVY STAGGER - Abrupt head and torso violent recoil, reeled backward.
- Pose 7 (Row 2, Col 2): HEAVY STAGGER - Deepest hunched recoil, torso rocked back hard, visibly lost balance and disrupted silhouette.
- Pose 8 (Row 2, Col 3): HEAVY STAGGER - Short legs splay wide and bend deeply to catch heavy body weight, low crouched compression.
- Pose 9 (Row 2, Col 4): HEAVY STAGGER - Pushing body back up forward toward ready stance.
- Pose 10 (Row 2, Col 5): HEAVY STAGGER - Fully recovered steady combat ready stance.

Style: Hand-painted digital dark fantasy game art. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, smooth opaque paint, cool upper-left key light, tiny subtle contact shadows directly under feet. Completely clean solid magenta #FF00FF background with wide empty gutters. No grid lines, no frame borders, no text, no numbers, no UI, no floor textures.
